junkville-assembly.chatter-1: Point of order ! Who stole the point of order ?
junkville-assembly.chatter-2: I move that we table the motion about the tables. Somepony stole them.
junkville-assembly.chatter-3: Can we vote on whether we should vote ?
junkville-assembly.chatter-4: Item four on the agenda: the smell. Again.
junkville-assembly.chatter-5: As stated in the minutes of the last meeting… nopony took minutes. Somepony ate the paper.
junkville-assembly.chatter-6: I'd like to speak on behalf of the radroaches, who cannot speak for themselves.
junkville-assembly.chatter-7: Funny how this anarchist utopia always votes whatever Randy suggests.
junkville-assembly.chatter-8: My motion was seconded by my own shadow. That counts, right ?
junkville-assembly.chatter-10: I demand a recount. Of the votes, and of the bottlecaps.
junkville-assembly.chatter-11: Who put "fix the roof" on the agenda again ? It's a skylight now. It's a feature.
junkville-assembly.chatter-12: Shh. I'm trying to nap with my eyes open.
junkville-assembly.chatter-13: Democracy is great, but have you ever tried a committee about a committee ?
junkville-assembly.chatter-14: This assembly is sponsored by the wasteland. Nopony else wanted to.
junkville-assembly.talk-1: Shh, we're in the middle of the communal assembly.
junkville-assembly.talk-2: Can it wait ? The assembly is on. Not that anypony is listening.
junkville-assembly.talk-3: Assembly time ! Sit down, speak up, and please don't mention the budget.
junkville-assembly.talk-4: Every evening, the same debate. Tonight's special: whose turn it is to bring snacks.
junkville-assembly.talk-5: I'd chat, but I have a very important seat to keep warm for the assembly.
junkville-assembly.talk-waiting-for: The communal assembly will start soon. We're still waiting on {{name}}.
junkville-assembly.talk-waiting-all-here: The communal assembly will start soon. I think everypony is here, we're just waiting for the formalities.
